description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe MP as the Minister of Policy Planning etc. & 27 other Ministers w.e.f. 12.01.2015. Appointed Hon. Nandimithra Ekanayake MP as the State Minister of Culture & 09 other Ministers w.e.f. 12.01.2015. Appointed Hon. Dunesh Gankanda MP as Deputy Ministers of Urban Development, Water Supply & Drainage & 08 other Deputy Ministers w.e.f. 12.01.2015.
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (e.g., Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, MP) AND detailed descriptions of their ministerial portfolios and responsibilities (e.g., "Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, child, Youth & Cultural Affairs"). This combination of naming people and specifying their detailed subject matter responsibilities meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
